what_it_does: Provides a one-time payout if the insured dies or becomes disabled due to an accident, helping to support family income and medical needs.
coverage_highlights: Accidental death benefit up to 100% of the sum insured
Permanent total disability payouts as per policy schedule
Permanent partial disability payouts based on injury scale
Hospital cash benefit in selected variants
Ambulance cost coverage up to specified limits
Broken bones and burns cover in certain variants
Financial support for dependent family members (e.g., education benefit in some plans)
sum_insured_range: Approximately ₹10 lakhs – ₹1 crore (may vary by age, occupation and underwriting).
important_conditions: No cover for death or disability that is not due to an accident (natural death excluded)
No cover for self-harm, suicide attempt or intentional injury
No cover if under the influence of alcohol or drugs beyond legal limits
No cover for participation in criminal acts, war, civil commotion or terrorism unless specifically included
Territorial scope is often worldwide but subject to policy wording and local regulations

insurer_metrics_notes.claim_settlement_ratio_trend: Health/Personal Accident claim settlement ratios for HDFC ERGO have broadly been in the ~90–95% zone in recent public disclosures (indicative).
insurer_metrics_notes.general_business_csr: Overall general insurance CSR also typically lies around 90–95% depending on product and year (approximate range).
insurer_metrics_notes.service_profile: Large hospital/partner network, digital-first claim notification and tracking, strong presence in health and PA segments.

best_for: People with a risky commute (e.g., two-wheeler riders) or hazardous work conditions
Individuals who already have life insurance but want an additional high-sum accident cover at relatively low cost

what_it_does: Provides lump-sum payouts on accidental death or disability with an option to cover hospitalization expenses due to accident.
coverage_highlights: Permanent partial disability benefit as per injury scale
Temporary total disability benefit (weekly compensation in some variants)
premium_example: ₹15 for every ₹25,000 of sum insured under the National Janata Personal Accident Policy (illustrative).
premium_depends_on: Occupational risk class of the policyholder (normal, medium, heavy)
Type of policy (individual vs. family floater)
Age and any applicable loadings as per underwriting

insurer_metrics_notes.claim_settlement_ratio_trend: As a PSU general insurer, National’s CSR and ICR are typically moderate to good, with relative stability over the years.
insurer_metrics_notes.service_profile: Strong legacy presence and trust; claim processes may be more traditional and sometimes slower than some private insurers.

best_for: Very price-sensitive customers seeking basic personal accident protection
Buyers who prefer PSU backing and are comfortable with a more traditional servicing experience
